'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oman]]
***[[Oman]] announces that it will repeal all COVID-19 restrictions, including its [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandate]]. [https://apnews.com/article/covid-health-middle-east-dubai-pandemics-cbb474fd6b6b2baf28e0b7a5192f357d (AP)]

**[[Austria]] confirms its first case of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/austrias-first-case-monkeypox-confirmed-vienna-health-authority-says-2022-05-22/ (Reuters)]
**[[Poland]] reports its first case of monkeypox. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/highly-unusual-who-on-monkeypox-spread-outside-africa-without-travel-links-101653190620722.html (''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021–22 Serie A]]
**[[A.C. Milan]] win the ''[[scudetto]]'' of the [[Serie A]], the highest level of [[Italian football league system|Italian league football]], after finishing the season with 86 points, two points more than runners-up and [[Derby della Madonnina|their intercity rivals]], [[Inter Milan]]. Milan win their 19th Serie A title overall and their first since the [[2010–11 Serie A|2010–11 season]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/sport/inter-win-final-day-relinquish-serie-title-milan-2699666 (CNA)]
*[[2021–22 Premier League]]
**[[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]] win their second consecutive [[2021–22 Premier League|Premier League]] title, their fourth in 5 years, and their sixth overall on the final day of the season following a 3–2 comeback against [[Aston Villa F.C.|Aston Villa]]. Manchester City win the league with 93 points, one point more than [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]]. This is the first time since 2019 that the title has been decided on the final day of the season. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/05/22/sports/soccer/premier-league-final-day.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2022 PGA Championship]]
**American [[professional golfer]] [[Justin Thomas]] wins the [[PGA Championship]], making it his second since [[2017 PGA Championship|2017]]. [https://www.espn.com/golf/story/_/id/33966687/justin-thomas-outlasts-zalatoris-3-hole-playoff-win-second-pga-championship (ESPN)]
